description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HistoryScreen' that displays the user's booking history for events. It fetches booking data from a provider, and displays either a message if there are no bookings or a list of booking tiles. Each tile navigates to a digital ticket screen when tapped.

classes.name: HistoryScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the booking history list.

classes.name: _BookingTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that represents a single booking item in the list, showing event details and navigating to the digital ticket screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the HistoryScreen widget, displaying booking history or a no bookings message.

methods.name: _BookingTile.build
methods.description: Builds the individual booking list tile with event info and navigation.
